findings.description: A parameter without '=' (e.g. 'charset' in 'text/html; charset') is now stored with the boolean value True. get_encoding_from_headers then calls .strip() on that value at line 544, which raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a Content-Type header such as 'text/html; charset' with a bare charset token. Before this change the token was skipped, so the header parsed without error. Now params['charset'] is True, and line 544 calls True.strip(...), raising AttributeError. The impact is that response.encoding access or text decoding crashes for such malformed headers instead of falling back to the default encoding.
